API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIForwarding Control PolicyProxy Resource Get Proxy By ID
Proxy Resource Get Proxy By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/proxies/:proxyId

Retrieves the proxy information based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
proxyId
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the proxy

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Proxy ID

name
string
REQUIRED

Proxy name

type
string

Gateway type

Possible values: [PROXYCHAIN, ZIA, ECSELF]

address
string
REQUIRED

The IP address or the FQDN of the third-party proxy service

port
int32
REQUIRED

The port number on which the third-party proxy service listens to the requests forwarded from Zscaler

cert
object
description
string

Additional notes or information

insertXauHeader
boolean

Flag indicating whether X-Authenticated-User header is added by the proxy. Enable to automatically insert authenticated user ID to the HTTP header, X-Authenticated-User.

base64EncodeXauHeader
boolean

Flag indicating whether the added X-Authenticated-User header is Base64 encoded. When enabled, the user ID is encoded using the Base64 encoding method.

lastModifiedBy
object
lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp of when the proxy was last modified
